extension.description: Confluence-jjs preserves the simple and direct Confluence interface while extending it with scalable front and back artwork, a song popup with track selection, synchronized lyrics and credits, configurable playback information, fonts and colors, an integrated Menu Editor, and settings backup and restore. Based on Confluence by Jezz_X / Team Kodi.
